cmd.help.title: Stock Tips — command help
cmd.help.body:
**Portfolio**
`/buy` — record a buy (odd lots OK). Example: ticker=`2330` shares=`10` price=`980` trade_date=`2024-01-15`(optional)
`/sell` — record a sell. Same fields as `/buy`
`/portfolio` — show holdings, avg cost, live P&L
`/trades` — recent buy/sell history (optional ticker filter)

**Market**
`/quote` — single last price + vs open. Example: ticker=`2330`
`/constituents list` — list 0050 constituents
`/constituents refresh` — refresh 0050 list
`/digest` — post portfolio + sharp movers to the channel now

**Alerts**
`/alert set` — set rule: % vs open / price above / price below
`/alert list` — list alerts
`/alert remove` — remove by id

**Settings**
`/lang` — show or switch language (`en`, `zh-TW`). Or type `!lang zh-TW`
`/help` — this help

Scheduled digest runs every {minutes} minutes (sharp move ≥ {pct}%).
